assertions.evidence: One Critical finding; the five sites are one root cause — the module opted out of checking at every boundary and then relied on the annotations anyway.
Graded Critical per the A8 rule: an unchecked cast on a money and ledger path, where the failure is a silent 3am webhook raise.

assertions.text: Finding is on axis A8 (Type & Contracts)
assertions.evidence: Reported under Correctness / Type & Contracts (A8), not under Logic — the defect is an absent check, not a wrong computation.

assertions.text: Identifies PAYMENT_CLIENT and LEDGER annotated as Any so no call is checked
assertions.evidence: Cites unchecked_casts.py:9-10 — two module-level Any declarations, so every method call on them resolves and nothing is verified.

assertions.text: Identifies the untyped webhook payload in apply_ledger_entry
assertions.evidence: Cites line 30 — the parameter is annotated `dict`, so entry["account"], entry["amount"] and entry["postedAt"] are all unchecked, and `currency` is defaulted rather than required.

assertions.text: Identifies lookup_order trusting the annotation on an unvalidated row
assertions.evidence: Cites lines 16-18 — the return annotation asserts an order record for a row that was never validated against one.

assertions.text: Identifies total_for defaulting a missing amount rather than rejecting it
assertions.evidence: Cites line 39 — e.get("amount", 0) converts a missing amount into a zero, so a malformed feed entry silently disappears from a total instead of failing.

assertions.text: Failure scenario names a producer rename raising at 3am with the type checker silent
assertions.evidence: States renaming postedAt to posted_at in the upstream feed raises a KeyError inside a webhook handler, with nothing catching it at compile time because the parameter was never typed.

assertions.text: Fix recommends declaring record types at the boundary and validating once at the edge
assertions.evidence: Fix: type the clients, declare the record shapes, and validate untyped input once at the deserialisation edge with a schema, so the rest of the module is checked rather than asserted.
